sub_graphs.title: EIP-778: Ethereum Node Record Lifecycle
sub_graphs.description: Models the lifecycle of ENR records from creation through propagation in the P2P network

nodes.label: ENR Record Unsigned
nodes.description: Node record content assembled with sequence number and key-value pairs but not yet signed

nodes.label: Compute Keccak256 Hash
nodes.description: Apply keccak256 hash function to the RLP-encoded content [seq, k, v, ...]

nodes.label: Create Secp256k1 Signature
nodes.description: Generate secp256k1 signature over the keccak256 hash, concatenating r and s values (64 bytes, no recovery ID)

nodes.label: ENR Record Signed
nodes.description: Complete node record with valid signature prepended: [signature, seq, k, v, ...]

nodes.label: RLP Encode Record
nodes.description: Encode the complete signed record using RLP encoding format

nodes.label: ENR Record Encoded
nodes.description: Binary RLP-encoded record ready for transmission or storage

nodes.label: Base64 URL-Safe Encode
nodes.description: Encode binary record using URL-safe Base64 alphabet and prefix with 'enr:'

nodes.label: ENR in Text Format
nodes.description: Human-readable text representation of ENR prefixed with 'enr:'

external_entities.name: Node Operator
external_entities.description: Entity controlling the node's identity keypair and connectivity information

sub_graphs.title: EIP-778: ENR Validation Rules
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation process for incoming ENR records including size limits, signature verification, and format checks

nodes.label: ENR Record Received
nodes.description: Raw ENR data received from external source (DNS, ENS, peer, etc.)

nodes.label: Check Size Limit
nodes.description: Verify that encoded record does not exceed 300 bytes maximum

nodes.label: Size Within Limit
nodes.description: Record size is 300 bytes or less

nodes.label: Size Limit Exceeded
nodes.description: Record exceeds 300 byte limit - must be rejected

nodes.label: Decode RLP Structure
nodes.description: Parse RLP-encoded record into [signature, seq, k, v, ...] components

nodes.label: RLP Structure Decoded
nodes.description: Record successfully parsed into signature and key-value pairs

nodes.label: RLP Malformed
nodes.description: RLP decoding failed - invalid structure

nodes.label: Validate Key Ordering
nodes.description: Verify keys are sorted and unique (no duplicate keys allowed)

nodes.label: Key Ordering Valid
nodes.description: Keys are properly sorted and unique

nodes.label: Extract Identity Scheme
nodes.description: Read 'id' key value to determine which identity scheme is used (e.g., 'v4')

nodes.label: Verify Signature
nodes.description: Recompute keccak256 hash of content and verify secp256k1 signature matches

nodes.label: Signature Valid
nodes.description: Cryptographic signature verified successfully

nodes.label: Signature Invalid
nodes.description: Signature verification failed - record rejected

nodes.label: ENR Record Accepted
nodes.description: Record passed all validation checks and can be used

external_entities.name: Peer Node
external_entities.description: Remote Ethereum node providing ENR records via P2P protocol

external_entities.name: DNS Resolver
external_entities.description: DNS service providing ENR records via DNS discovery

external_entities.name: ENS Registry
external_entities.description: Ethereum Name Service providing ENR records

sub_graphs.title: EIP-778: Trust Boundaries for ENR Processing
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundaries where untrusted ENR data enters the system from external sources

nodes.label: Untrusted ENR Data
nodes.description: Raw ENR bytes from external, potentially malicious source

nodes.label: Validate Cryptographic Binding
nodes.description: Verify ENR is cryptographically bound to the claimed node identity via signature

nodes.label: Node Identity Verified
nodes.description: ENR proven to originate from holder of private key

nodes.label: Derive Node Address
nodes.description: Compute node address as keccak256 hash of uncompressed public key

nodes.label: Node Address Known
nodes.description: 64-byte node ID derived from public key

nodes.label: Extract Connectivity Info
nodes.description: Parse IP addresses, TCP/UDP ports from ENR key-value pairs

nodes.label: Connectivity Info Extracted
nodes.description: Network addresses and ports available for connection attempts

edges.label: Enter trust boundary via crypto validation

external_entities.name: DNS Discovery Source
external_entities.description: External DNS infrastructure providing ENR records - potentially subject to DNS spoofing

external_entities.name: P2P Peer Source
external_entities.description: Remote peer on devp2p network - may be malicious

external_entities.name: ENS Source
external_entities.description: Ethereum Name Service resolver - depends on on-chain data integrity

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when an unknown identity scheme is encountered
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume records with unknown identity schemes should be rejected as unverifiable, since signature validation requires scheme-specific logic

ambiguities.text: The phrase 'endpoint information is not required' is ambiguous - unclear if records without endpoints should be propagated or only stored locally
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume records without endpoints are valid for identity purposes but should not be used for connection attempts

ambiguities.text: No specification for how sequence numbers should increment or what constitutes a 'newer' record beyond simple comparison
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume strictly greater sequence number indicates newer record; wraparound at 2^64 is undefined but likely rejection

implicit_assumptions.description: The secp256k1 elliptic curve and keccak256 hash function are cryptographically secure
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Signature forgery possible, allowing impersonation of arbitrary node identities

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot recover the private key from the public key in the ENR or from multiple signatures
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Node identity theft; attacker could create valid ENRs for victim nodes

implicit_assumptions.description: DNS infrastructure used for ENR discovery provides authentic responses (DNSSEC or trusted resolver)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: DNS spoofing could direct nodes to malicious peers, but crypto validation limits impact to DoS

implicit_assumptions.description: Nodes properly increment sequence numbers when updating their ENR
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Stale records may persist; potential for replay of old connectivity information
